# Hashtag Web3 — API scoped context (legacy path)

The `/api/*` tree is **not** a catalog API on production. Use:

- `https://hashtagweb3.com/data/jobs-runtime.json`
- `https://hashtagweb3.com/data/news-cache.json`
- `https://hashtagweb3.com/data/events-runtime.json`
- `https://hashtagweb3.com/data/glossary-runtime.json`

OpenAPI: `https://hashtagweb3.com/openapi.json`
